project_type: Tauri v2 desktop app: Rust core (workspace of 8 crates under hybrid-orchestrator/crates/) + React/TypeScript (Vite) webview under hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/
build_system: Cargo per-crate (workspace members array is EMPTY; every crate is under [workspace] exclude and built via --manifest-path). Frontend: npm/Vite. Never use `cargo fmt --all` / bare `cargo build` (acts on nothing offline) - always per-crate --manifest-path.
test_framework: Rust: cargo test per-crate with #[cfg(test)] modules and tests/ integration dirs (wiremock for adapter contract tests). Frontend: vitest + @testing-library/react with @tauri-apps/api mocked via vi.mock.
build_command: Per-crate: cargo build --manifest-path crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml . Frontend: (cd frontend && npm run build). NOT runnable offline (crates.io + npm 403); real gate is GitHub CI.
test_command: Per-crate: cargo test --manifest-path crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml . Frontend: (cd frontend && npm run test). NOT runnable offline; real gate is GitHub CI.
verification_instructions: OFFLINE-ONLY checks feasible in this sandbox: per-crate `cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml --check` and, from frontend/, `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` IF the prettier binary is present; plus manual code review / AST-level reasoning. cargo build/test/clippy, eslint, tsc, vitest, and tauri build all require network and run ONLY in GitHub CI (the orchestrator drives that after push). SELF-AUDIT the four failure classes that cost prior CI cycles: (i) clippy -D warnings (no unused imports - adjust imports when a type usage is added/removed; no needless_lifetimes/useless_vec; no doc_lazy_continuation); (ii) TS eslint no-unused-vars; (iii) tsc strict (no undefined field reads); (iv) vitest - EVERY test that mounts <App/> or the settings/model-selector surfaces must have `invoke` mocks returning well-formed shapes for ALL commands it calls, INCLUDING the NEW provider_diagnostics command and the existing list_available_models ({models,errors}); a new IPC call must never resolve `undefined`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in that this task regenerates. Cargo.lock and frontend/package-lock.json are committed lockfiles but this task adds no dependencies, so they must NOT change.
setup_instructions: No dependency install possible offline. Work against the source tree directly on the feature branch feat/model-picker-diagnostics-selfreport (already created from main).
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network: crates.io and npm return 403, no Tauri CLI, no live Ollama, no live cloud endpoint. Cannot run cargo build/clippy/test, eslint/tsc/vitest, or tauri build locally. Do NOT push/tag/PR - the orchestrator publishes. Do NOT add new dependencies (no offline lockfile regen).
contribution_requirements: Match existing conventions precisely. Any NEW Tauri command MUST be: (1) a #[tauri::command] with an _inner testable body (established pattern), (2) registered in generate_handler! in crates/tauri-app/src/lib.rs, (3) given a frontend IPC wrapper in frontend/src/ipc/commands.ts, (4) mirrored by a hand-written TS type in frontend/src/types/index.ts. Boundary structs use #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]. DISPLAY-SAFE discipline: never surface secret/key material or a resolved SecretRef across IPC or in error strings - base_url is display-safe, api_key_ref/keys are NOT. Format per-crate (never cargo fmt --all).
key_patterns: list_available_models_inner (commands.rs ~line 455) is the load path: ensure_ollama_provider_config (seeds a ProviderKind::Ollama row id 'ollama-local', base_url None) + ensure_embedded (implicit) -> ProviderRepo::list -> AppConfig pricing -> providers::build_registry(configs) -> registry.insert_instance(EmbeddedProvider::from_shared) -> providers::list_available_models(&registry,&configs,&pricing). CLEAN-EMPTY causes found: (A) FRONTEND: providers store load() in frontend/src/state/providers.ts does `const result = await listAvailableModels(); set({models: result.models ?? [], errors: result.errors ?? []})` - if the IPC call THROWS (backend returned CommandError), set() never runs and app.tsx's `void useProvidersStore.getState().load()` swallows the rejection, leaving models:[] AND errors:[] with NO visible error. (B) BACKEND: providers::list_available_models in crates/providers/src/builtins.rs has `let Some(instance) = registry.get(&cfg.id) else { continue };` - a configured row whose instance was never built contributes NEITHER a model NOR an error (invisible skip). (C) build_registry -> ProviderRegistry::build_all short-circuits on the FIRST build failure with `?`, so one bad config row aborts the WHOLE enumeration (turns into a thrown CommandError -> cause A). The fix must make each of these self-report.
